critical_code_review_comments: Validation in PUT /admin/affiliate/settings short-circuits on first invalid field — acceptable for an admin form but if main agent ever wants per-field error rendering, prefer Pydantic validators returning all errors at once.

AffiliateSettings Pydantic model uses Optional[float] for percent fields with no Field(..., ge=0, le=100) constraints — server-side range check is done manually in the handler. Works, but moving to Pydantic Field constraints would surface the limits in OpenAPI for the admin UI.

AdminAffiliatePage.js does an unguarded `useEffect` axios.get on mount even when user is not super-admin (the early return happens but the network request still fires). Tiny — but a `return early` before the axios call would be cleaner.

needsSubscriptionBilling check in AdminAffiliatePage.js OR's three conditions (active_subscription_60d / first_paid_subscription / mrr_commission_percent>0). Logic is correct but the warning copy only mentions MRR/active-N-days — consider also calling out 'first paid subscription' to avoid confusing the owner if they pick that option.
No audit log entry for PUT /admin/affiliate/settings — flagged in iter14 review; still applies. Becomes important once real payouts are wired in.

Default seed of stripe_connect_enabled=false is correct, but there is no startup hook that creates the owner user. Owner was clearly seeded manually (via mongo or earlier iteration script). For reproducible cold-start environments, a documented seed script would be valuable.
